preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi, ti in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ti <= 10**18 for ui, vi, ti in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a non-negative integer weight ti between 0 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is within the range 0 to 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(s for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(u+1, n+1) for s in get_interesting_s_values(u, v, edges)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of all interesting s values for all triples (u, v, s) modulo 10^9 + 7.
